fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for the usage-limit pause change set. No owner was present, so no owner words exist to quote. The one question raised (how a usage-limited run resumes) went to the arbiter, who decided: resume the same agent session with the Claude CLI's resume flag, keyed on the session ID the run already stores; start a fresh session only when the transcript is missing. Still open for the owner: how a run recognises the usage limit and how long it waits before resuming.
fields.title: Usage-limit pause, planning interview (autonomous)
